title: Start processing run
subtitle: Review the estimate and requirements before starting. Processing is a costly operation and needs explicit confirmation.

loadError.title: Preflight unavailable
loadError.message: The estimate could not be loaded, so starting is blocked. No run was started.

status.warning: This project is currently {{status}}. The server only starts validated projects, so starting now will likely be rejected — the server has the final say.
status.archived: Archived projects cannot start processing. Unarchive the project first, then start again.

estimate.label: Estimated cost
estimate.note: Estimates are planning figures only — never promises. Actual cost is metered server-side.
estimate.timeNote: Run time varies with media length and pipeline load. No ETA is promised.

quota.title: Quota
quota.impactNote: Starting a run creates no project, so the daily project quota is unchanged. The per-project cost budget is still enforced server-side at start.
quota.exhausted: The daily project quota is exhausted. Starting is a costly operation — enter an override reason to confirm explicitly, or wait for the reset.
quota.overrideHint: Required while the daily quota is exhausted. Record why this run cannot wait.
quota.blocked: The server rejected the start: the per-project cost budget would be exceeded. Review usage with your tenant admin before retrying.

config.title: Configuration
config.speakersTruncated: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} speakers. Consent covers the listed voices; the server re-validates every assignment.

consent.title: Voice-cloning consent
consent.description: The speakers below use cloned voices. Starting is blocked until you acknowledge consent for every listed voice.
consent.check: I acknowledge that recorded consent covers each cloned voice listed above.

actions.openWorkspace: Open workspace to cancel the run

blocks.starting: A start request is already in flight.
blocks.conflict: A run is already active. Cancel it in the workspace first.
blocks.quota: Enter an override reason to start while the daily quota is exhausted.

conflict.title: A run is already active
conflict.message: Project already has an active run ({{status}}). Starting is disabled — cancel the active run in the workspace first, then start again.
